title: Filtered shifted Hom continuity is closed under extensions
statement:
Let $\mathcal T$ be a pretriangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category], $I$ a small
filtered category, $D:I\to\mathcal T$ a diagram and $c$ a cocone. With $H(D,c)$ as defined in
[def-weil-pbc-hom-colimit-property], for every distinguished triangle
$A\to B\to C\to A[1]$, the conditions $H(D,c)(A)$ and $H(D,c)(C)$ imply $H(D,c)(B)$.

source.place: Original declaration docstring, expanded geometric argument steps 1--7, following Hemo--Richarz--Scholbach 5.3(2)

proof.text: For a fixed shift $n$, the functor $K\mapsto\varinjlim_i\operatorname{Hom}(K,D_i[n])$ on $\mathcal T^{op}$ is homological: evaluate the short complex of diagrams at each $i$ and use the distinguished triangle Hom exact sequence, then apply exactness of filtered colimits of abelian groups.

source.place: Original declaration docstring, expanded geometric argument steps 1--7, following Hemo--Richarz--Scholbach 5.3(2)

proof.text: The maps to $\operatorname{Hom}(K,c_\infty[n])$ are natural in $K$: after precomposing with each colimit inclusion this is associativity of composition. Shift adjunction gives $H(D,c)(K[m])$ from $H(D,c)(K)$ for every $m$; the natural isomorphism identifies the canonical desc maps by the colimit universal property.

source.place: Original declaration docstring, expanded geometric argument steps 1--7, following Hemo--Richarz--Scholbach 5.3(2)

proof.text: Apply the five lemma to the five-term window obtained from the opposite triangle and its inverse rotation. Its terms are Hom(A,-[n-1]), Hom(C,-[n]), Hom(B,-[n]), Hom(A,-[n]), Hom(C,-[n+1]). The four outer comparisons are isomorphisms by the assumptions and shift adjunction. The middle comparison is the required map.
